description: This file contains helper functions and validation logic for Kubernetes CSR (Certificate Signing Request) processing, specifically for kubelet serving and client CSRs, including organization and subject validation, and usage checks.

methods.name: ParseCSR
methods.description: Extracts and decodes a CSR from PEM bytes.

methods.name: IsKubeletServingCSR
methods.description: Checks if a CSR is a valid kubelet serving CSR based on usages.

methods.name: ValidateKubeletServingCSR
methods.description: Validates the CSR for kubelet serving, including organization, SANs, and usage.

methods.name: IsKubeletClientCSR
methods.description: Checks if a CSR is a valid kubelet client CSR based on usages.

methods.name: ValidateKubeletClientCSR
methods.description: Validates the CSR for kubelet client, including organization, SANs, and usage.
